name: clawd-companion
description: Unofficial fan-made companion window for Claude Code sessions

scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:web
scripts.build:cli: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --minify --outfile=dist/clawd.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
